method: Actual encoded-frame images were placed into a private review document, converted to PDF, and inspected as rendered page images. The temporary review documents were not shared publicly.
observations: Opening and eruption frames show the interior caldera and molten lake, rather than only a foreground rock wall.
Dark patches are visible within the glowing molten surface. Rock relief and channels remain discernible, although haze still softens the close-up contrast.
Ballistic molten fragments and their short trails are visible above the crater in the opening and eruption frames.

The first chronology frame shows the advancing illuminated path without the 3.4-billion-year headline; the next sampled frame shows the lit interval and the headline. Endpoint labels remain distinct and readable.
The sampled ocean-formation frames change from an active rocky globe with a small water area to a predominantly blue ocean globe.
The coastal foam is broken into irregular patches rather than a continuous white band; the foreground rock leaves the main volcanic silhouette visible.
The same volcanic silhouette and surface channels recur across the coastal and high-angle views.
The final sampled frame is underwater with readable terrain, light shafts and the closing subtitle.
All 20 sampled Japanese subtitle blocks fit inside the image, retain sensible one- or two-line breaks, and are legible at the reviewed size.
pronunciation_check: Inherited corrected VOICEVOX query readings, including Orion arm as オリオンワン, were checked against the recorded kana. This is a data check, not ear listening.
audio_preservation: Final assembly reports AAC payload equality with the accepted preceding cut; no narration or music re-encoding was introduced.
scope_limitations: Sampled still-frame inspection does not certify every in-between frame or the subjective pace of continuous motion.
Automatic two-second pixel-change checks are editing aids, not a guarantee of excitement or comprehension.
The visual world is a stylized 3D reconstruction; volcanic ejection, ocean rise and chronology are time-compressed explanatory staging.
delivery_status: Complete narrated video ready for the user's continuous viewing review.
